name: Shyama Computronics and Services Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, Shyama Computronics 
and Services Ltd is in the business of IT-enabled services and investment & trading in shares and securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SCSL mainly provides information technology services. Apart from that, it is also engaged in investment activities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.49 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of -1.79% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 4,380 days.
